definition: The time it takes for half of the unstable nuclei of an isotope in a sample to decay, which is also the time for the corrected count rate from it to halve; it is the same for any amount of that isotope.
A graph of the count rate, or the number of unstable nuclei left, against time for a radioactive sample: it falls less and less steeply, and with background ignored it halves in each half-life.
